name: Wardha

source.name: Satpura Range, near Multai, Betul district

sink.name: Confluence with the Wainganga, forming the Pranhita
sink.location: Near Sirpur Kaghaznagar, Kumaram Bheem Asifabad district, Telangana

did_you_know: The Wardha rises near Multai in Madhya Pradesh, close to the same Satpura watershed traditionally cited as the Tapi's source — but the two rivers flow in opposite directions.
The city of Wardha, associated with Mahatma Gandhi's Sevagram ashram, takes its name from the river.
